title: Han er ikke her, han er oppstått

request.style: English, Lutheran Easter chorale, a full congregation singing in unison with a pipe organ and a trumpet descant, triumphant even notes, D major, bright and festive, 4/4, 80 BPM, sung in English
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
They came to the tomb at early dawn
To find the Lord who died
An angel said, Do not be afraid
I know whom you have sought

[Verse]
He is not here, for he is risen
Just as he said, it now is done
Come, see the place where once he lay
The grave by life is overcome

[Verse]
Now go and tell his followers
He has risen from the dead
He goes before you to Galilee
And there you will see him

[Verse]
So sing, all people, Easter morning
Our Lord is living, he is here
He is not here, for he is risen
The empty grave is always near
